cond_0001.intro:
Corporate Tax department of a large multi-national service corporation. The department is responsible for filing a consolidated federal income tax return, with approximately 85 subsidiaries. Also, the department files 27 combined state income tax returns and approximately 900 separate company state and local income and franchise tax returns. In addition, the tax department is heavily involved with the company's compliance with ASC 740.
Note: Employment-based non-immigrant visa sponsorship and/or assistance is not offered for this specific job opportunity.
cond_0001.responsibilities:
Support the U.S. Federal income tax compliance process in order to meet external filing requirements
Prepare US federal proforma and consolidated return items, including any book-tax adjustments
Prepare US state income and franchise tax returns
Prepare calculations for estimated payments and extensions
Preparation of Forms 5471 and Form 8858 for international entities
Provide support on annual and quarterly tax provision calculations, including any book-tax adjustments, tax account reconciliations and return to provision calculations
cond_0001.requirements:
Minimum Requirements:
Undergraduate degree in Accounting
Ability to comprehend income tax accounting theory and tax compliance laws
Basic understanding of US Internal Revenue Code and ASC 740
Highly proficient in Microsoft Office
Strong analytical and communication skills
Ability to work independently and with others as a team
Preferred Requirements:
Masters in Tax
Prior internship/tax experience (0-4 years), with US outbound experience a plus
Experience with [Product name masked] and/or [Product name masked]; [Product name masked]; Alteryx; Oracle/SAP
Pillar II experience a plus

Also, the department files 27 combined state income tax returns and approximately 900 separate company state and local income and franchise tax returns. In addition, the tax department is heavily involved with the company's compliance with ASC 740.
Note: Employment-based non-immigrant visa sponsorship and/or assistance is not offered for this specific job opportunity.
People who do well in this role are often quick to grasp tax compliance processes and income tax accounting concepts.
cond_0202.responsibilities:
Support the U.S. Federal income tax compliance process in order to meet external filing requirements
Prepare US federal proforma and consolidated return items, including any book-tax adjustments
Prepare US state income and franchise tax returns
Prepare calculations for estimated payments and extensions
Preparation of Forms 5471 and Form 8858 for international entities
Provide support on annual and quarterly tax provision calculations, including any book-tax adjustments, tax account reconciliations and return to provision calculations
cond_0202.requirements:
Minimum Requirements:
Undergraduate degree in Accounting
Ability to comprehend income tax accounting theory and tax compliance laws
Highly proficient in Microsoft Office
Strong analytical and communication skills
Basic understanding of US Internal Revenue Code and ASC 740
Ability to work independently and with others as a team
Preferred Requirements:
Masters in Tax
Prior internship/tax experience (0-4 years), with US outbound experience a plus
Experience with [Product name masked] and/or [Product name masked]; [Product name masked]; Alteryx; Oracle/SAP
Pillar II experience
cond_0202.values: We value work that reflects care for people and consideration for its wider impact. We aim to make decisions in ways that are responsible, fair, and respectful.
